name: Unconstrained UncheckedAccount
description: UncheckedAccount fields bypass Anchor's ownership and type validation, so without an address, owner, seeds, or constraint attribute a caller can substitute an arbitrary account into the instruction.

name: Invoke Signed Unvalidated Seeds
description: invoke_signed lends the program's PDA signature to a cross-program invocation. When the target program or account keys derive from caller-supplied accounts without a require_keys_eq check, an attacker can redirect the signed invocation to a malicious target.
